summary: Connect your agents to ZGAP. Sign in with Google, choose a model, and manage everything in magpie.
headline: One sign-in.
intro: Bring ZGAP’s models to the agents you use. Start in magpie and approve the connection in your browser.
setupTitle: Three steps. All in the UI.
signInBody: Open the installed ZGAP plugin and click Sign in. You can also choose Providers → Add provider → From plugins → ZGAP.
approveBody: Use your ZGAP Google account and approve the request. Return to magpie when it finishes. Your account must be approved by the ZGAP administrator.
agentTitle: Choose a model for your agent
agentBody: Open Agents, select the agent you use, and pick a model under ZGAP. Follow magpie’s connection prompt. Restart the agent if magpie asks you to.
renewBody: magpie renews your session automatically. If access is revoked or renewal expires, use Sign in again.
catalogBody: The model list comes from ZGAP after sign-in. Your administrator controls which models are available.
privacyBody: magpie stores the sign-in on this computer. Requests include device information, the working directory, project name and session ID for ZGAP diagnostics. Those headers contain no prompts or command lines.
revokeBody: To disconnect this device, open the ZGAP console → Connect → OAuth and log out its magpie session.
footer: Menu names above follow magpie’s English interface.
